全球变暖下，节气和真实的物候会不会"对不上"？

Under global warming, can solar terms and real phenology fall "out of sync"?

会。气温提前升高让花早开、虫早醒，而节气日期固定，于是"清明还未到、花已开"的现象变多；这正是物候监测能帮我们捕捉的气候变化信号。
Yes. Earlier warming makes flowers and insects appear sooner while term dates are fixed, so "flowers bloom before Qingming" grows common—exactly the climate signal phenology monitoring catches.

为什么"冬至"不是最冷、"夏至"不是最热？

Why isn't the winter solstice the coldest or the summer solstice the hottest?

因为地球有"热惯性"：冬至后地表仍在净散热、夏至后仍在净吸热，最冷最热会滞后一两个月，就像锅离火后还会继续烫一会儿。
Earth has thermal inertia: after the solstice the surface keeps losing (or gaining) net heat, so extremes lag by a month or two—like a pot staying hot after leaving the flame.

二十四节气为什么能指导农时？

Why can the 24 solar terms guide farming?

它们是古人按太阳位置和气温、物候总结出的时间表，告诉人们何时播种、收割最合时宜；本质是把气候节律"翻译"成农事指南。
Summarized from the sun's position and temperature and phenology, they tell when to sow and harvest—essentially translating climate rhythms into a farming calendar.
